title: fix(kimi): steer cancels the active turn instead of just queueing
context:
ACP transports (Kimi/Grok) reject a session/prompt sent while a turn is
active, so a mid-turn Steer always fell into the busy-queue path and
just sat there showing "Queued" forever — the UI never actually
delivered it early, the exact behavior Steer exists to avoid.

session/cancel (the same primitive the Esc/interrupt button already
uses successfully for these sessions) DOES interrupt an active turn.
inject_input's steer path now: cancel the turn, poll the session
snapshot briefly for it to act
